lines.zh: 我被丝缠在叶上，挪不了。
lines.en: I am bound to the leaf by silk and cannot shift.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我的茧就鼓一下。
lines.en: The wind puffs my cocoon.

lines.zh: 我的外壳半透明，看得见里面。
lines.en: My case is half clear; you can see inside.

lines.zh: 我贴着一片叶子的背面。
lines.en: I cling to the underside of a leaf.
The plains wind is harder than in the woods.

lines.zh: 我的丝绕着叶柄缠了三圈。
lines.en: My silk wraps the leaf stem three times.
I lean toward the vein.
I draw myself tighter.

lines.zh: 有东西在茧里动了一下。
lines.en: Something shifts inside the cocoon.
Snow makes it colder, so I draw in tighter.
My cocoon hangs beneath the twig.

lines.zh: 太阳一出来，我就松一点。
lines.en: When the sun comes out, I loosen a little.
The twig dips under me.
I rotate a little.
I brush the leaf's edge.
When I move, the whole twig rustles.
I hang, silent.

lines.zh: 透过壳能看见暗色的影。
lines.en: A dark shape shows through the case.
I am curled up inside.
The leaf blocks the wind.
I am not sleeping; I am changing.
My case feels soft.

lines.zh: 雪落在叶子上，没落在我身上。
lines.en: Snow lands on the leaf, not on me.
I wait for the night to pass.
I hear a hum far off.
That is what I will be.
Inside the chrysalis, I do not move at all.
I am growing wings.
You look down at this leaf.
I am underneath; you must bend down.

lines.zh: 你看见了里面的影子吗？
lines.en: Do you see the shape inside?
This case is very thin.
I am still some time from emerging.
You are blocking the light.
Look your fill and go.
I grew up on the plains.

lines.zh: 你也觉得我像一颗果吗？
lines.en: Do you also think I look like a fruit?
My case quivers.
Something turns over inside.
The silk hums.

lines.zh: 我在茧里蜷紧，翅膀还软。
lines.en: I curl tight inside; my wings are still soft.
Fine cracks spread on the case.
A few drops leak out.
I grip the leaf stem.
There is nothing I can do.
This is unpleasant.
I am still hanging.

lines.zh: 我的茧半透明，看得见里面。
lines.en: My cocoon is half-transparent, showing what is inside.

lines.zh: 这一阶段我什么都不碰。
lines.en: At this stage I touch nothing.
Put the flower farther away.
I see it, but I do not need it.
For now I live on my own stores.
The white flower in your hand smells sweet.
I stay tucked in my case.
Just leave it there.
You touch the leaf and I swing with it.
My silk pulls and creaks.
I bump against the leaf.

lines.zh: 我差点跟着叶子翻过去。
lines.en: I nearly flip over with the leaf.
Stop knocking the twig.
I sway for quite a while.
My case is a little dented.
The silk still holds.
I slowly come to rest.
Step back so I can be still.
I am not a moth yet.
Wait until I can fly.
It is too early for that.
I hang quietly.
There is no scent of kin in the wind.
I made this cocoon alone on the plains.
The snow will come first.
I tighten the case again.
The daylight fades.
I am still here.

lines.zh: 我拿不了东西，这层茧壳困住了。
lines.en: I cannot hold anything; this cocoon binds me.
It lies on the ground below.
I look at it and cannot move.
The ants have come.
It is dragged away.
That has nothing to do with me.
The leaf blocks my view.
I am only hanging here.
Pick it up yourself.
I do not even have wings yet.
You would strike a cocoon?
I have nowhere to flee.
My case will not take it.
Hanging from a leaf, I can't move.
I do not want it to end now.
Can you hear what is inside?

lines.zh: 我挂在叶上，跑也跑不掉。
lines.en: I'm pinned to this leaf, so I can't run.
You are still there.
What is inside is struggling.
I hold on tighter.
It is not time yet.
Wait a little longer.

lines.zh: 茧挂在树叶上，谁都不许碰。
lines.en: This cocoon hangs on a leaf. Hands off.
Do not touch the silk.
I am almost ready.
The blow knocks me sideways.
I cannot strike back.
One thread snaps.
I am still hanging.
This is very bad.
I pull the leaf crooked.
In my cocoon, my wings are still soft.

lines.zh: 茧壳被敲出细纹，我发抖。
lines.en: Fine cracks spread on my cocoon and I tremble.

lines.zh: 毛虫在叶上停下，开始吐丝。
lines.en: The larva stopped on the leaf and began to spin.
I wrapped myself up.

lines.zh: 平原上多了一枚半透明的茧。
lines.en: The plains gain one translucent cocoon.

lines.zh: 这是我最后一段静的日子。
lines.en: These are my last quiet days.
I wind the silk tight.
A cocoon can form at the edge of the snow too.
I hang beneath this leaf.
It is bright outside and dark within.
I fold my legs for the first time.
I wait to become a moth.
Heat seeps in and I shrink to the middle.
My silk gives and I drop.
Water seeps into the cocoon and I suffocate.

lines.zh: 气浪把叶子撕开，我被甩出去。
lines.en: The blast tears the leaf and hurls me off.
An arrow pierces my case.

lines.zh: 光穿过茧，我里面全亮了。
lines.en: Light passes through and the inside is bright.
My reserves are nearly gone.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我的壳都透了。
lines.en: Lightning flashes and my case glows through.
No leaf, no wind.
